title: Season Gap Garden
user: A small-space food gardener who wants to spot an empty bed window and choose a simple follow-on crop from their own past planting notes.
smallest_useful_product: Offline bed list, sow/transplant/expected-clear dates, a calendar strip showing open windows, user-defined successor templates, and season CSV export.
constraints: No climate, pesticide, or food-safety claims; use only user-defined crop durations in v1; portable local data.
